global.title: Galileo Space Is Building Satellites That Turn Signals Into Answers in Orbit
global.summary: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers in orbit. Modern defense and commercial operations need fast answers about what is happening and where. Existing systems can leave segmented data crawling through processing for hours or days. FPV drones and moving radars must be detected and tracked quickly. Ballistic missile launch plume detection can provide critical early warning. Interference disrupting navigation frequencies or crucial satcom links must be detected
